name: Vertical batch furnace
description: Generic chip-fab vertical batch furnace: front section with load-port face, FOUP shelf and transfer robot behind a real window; back tower with boat area and elevator, hideable heater jacket, quartz tube, quartz boat and standby boat, gas lines, orange thermal family band at Y 1.9 to 2.0, lod1 sibling part.
brief: Foundry Floor special tool (group B, interior batch 3): vertical furnace, 4.5 x 2.0 x 3.8 m, +X working face with two load-port locators, foupShelf and transfer robot behind a window in the front section, back tower with boat area behind a window and heaterJacket around quartzTube. Clips BoatLoad and BoatUnload (8 s, one-shot). Built to briefs/vertical-furnace.md.
